final_message: I parsed the log file by reading it line by line and grouping lines into entries based on the log entry header pattern. For each entry, I extracted the timestamp, level, service, and message from the first line, collected any extra lines as traceback, and summed repeat counts from following repeat lines. I filtered only ERROR and CRITICAL level entries, converted timestamps to UTC ISO format, extracted the last traceback line as the exception or null if none, and counted repeats by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json in the required JSON structure following Acme log-triage conventions.
